# Odoo CRM | Product Overview

Odoo CRM is the CRM in the open-source application suite, which shares data with sales, accounting, inventory, projects, electricians and HR. The product core builds a unified workspace around customer relations, sales implementation and revenue processes, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
